newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh court sentences seven to death.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh court sentences seven to death.

text.p: A court in the west Bangladesh district of Kushtia has sentenced seven men to death for the murder of a local council chairman six years ago, the official BSS news agency said on Thursday.
Four of the convicted were sentenced in absentia as they have evaded arrest so far.
The seven were convicted of shooting Mahbubul Alam Bulu at his home on April 9, 1991.
Executions are by hanging in Bangladesh and rarely made public. The last known execution was in 1989.
